verdict.rationale: Cline runs in a terminal, reacts live to test/build/dev-server output, and takes natural-language fix requests (e.g. 'fix the layout issue shown in @screenshot.png'), which is the core mechanism for NL-driven debugging/troubleshooting, and community reports confirm it can autonomously diagnose and produce correct diffs after being set loose on a codebase. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation on debugging workflows (e.g. stack-trace analysis, breakpoint/log inspection) and independent hands-on verification specifically of debugging accuracy rather than general coding tasks.
